content.comment_body: Hello, I have set up an automation using [product_name] and need to know the maximum current or power that its outputs (Q1, Q2, Q3, Q4) can handle. I want to avoid buying extra relays for small loads like alarm beepers and emergency lights, as everything operates at 230V. Any advice?
Hello [user_name], the details are available in the manual, which you can download from [url]. Regards, [user_name]

analysis.insight_summary: A user is looking for technical data about the maximum output current or power per channel of a [product_name], aiming to decide if additional relays are needed for low-power equipment. The main concern is that the necessary information was not quickly accessible, prompting them to ask in the forum.
analysis.user_expectations: User expects technical details about output capacity to be clearly presented and easy to find, allowing for efficient hardware selection and system design.
